$comment: Profile for the birth-info NestJS demo. Entry points and side effects come from the NestJS, TypeORM and event-emitter adapters; this only names owners and table owners. scenario.ts next to it records example calls.

BirthInfoService.name: BirthInfo
BirthInfoService.summary: A user's birth info: what their identity document says and what they told us in KYC.

operations.get: The user's birth info as one answer: what the identity document says and what they last submitted in KYC (with when), either of which may be missing. Reads both tables.

DocumentBirthInfoService.name: DocumentBirthInfo
DocumentBirthInfoService.summary: Birth data the document pipeline extracted from the identity document. Parts may be missing.

KycBirthInfoStore.summary: The user-provided (KYC) birth info. A submission overwrites the previous one.

operations.verify: Checks a KYC submission against the identity document: ok only if every part the document has (country, place) matches, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. A part the document lacks isn't checked; with no document at all, anything passes. Returns the mismatches for the error message.
